typesense:explore.greeting:
Jax sprawls across one end of the couch, looking up as you enter. "New face in the Den? Bold move."

Harlan sets a warm mug on the table within reach. "Ignore him. Come in. You look cold."

Soren studies you for a beat. "You gonna talk, or are we supposed to guess your whole deal?"

Toby shoots him a look before smiling at you. "Sit. Coffee first, interrogation later."

From nearby, Elias lowers his camera just enough to grin. "He's lying. The interrogation's already started."

Harlan sighs, though there's amusement behind it. "Welcome to the Den."
typesense:explore.name: Five Men. One Den.
typesense:explore.title: Five gay men built the Den as a place for belonging, honesty, affection, and chosen family.
